title.a: 恩典之洋（即使我仍會軟弱）

meta.author:
詞／曲：Joel Houston, Matt Crocker, Salomon Lighthelm
中譯詞：周巽光、李曉茹

lines.b: You call me out upon the waters

lines.a: 跨入未知 深怕失落
lines.b: The great unknown, where feet may fail
And there I find You in the mystery

lines.a: 在深海裡 我仍站立
lines.b: In oceans deep, my faith will stand
I will call upon Your name
And keep my eyes above the waves

lines.a: 大海翻騰 我卻安息 在祢懷裡
lines.b: When oceans rise, my soul will rest in Your embrace

lines.a: 因祢屬我 而我屬祢
lines.b: For I am Yours, You are mine

lines.a: 水深之處 祢恩典湧流
lines.b: Your grace abounds in deepest waters

lines.a: 祢手掌權 牽引著我
lines.b: Your sovereign hand will be my guide
Where feet may fail and fear surrounds me

lines.a: 祢永不失手 扶持著我
lines.b: You've never failed and You won't start now

lines.a: 聖靈引領 使我信心沒有界線
lines.b: Spirit lead me where my trust is without borders
Let me walk upon the waters

lines.a: 祢牽引我 讓我更深與祢同行
lines.b: Take me deeper than my feet could ever wander
And my faith will be made stronger
In the presence of my Savior
